snippet.title: Aliens vs. Ghosts *NEW UPDATE*
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1609730/Aliens_vs_Ghosts/

Update includes:
Online co-op
New classes/upgrades
New map
New boss fights
Improved visuals and sound
Improved mechanics
Infinite rounds

Support this channel: https://www.patreon.com/sayan23
Discord: https://discord.gg/JxTEXTAh2t
Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCDFQlbO9DkC0L6p1inrk7aw?sub_confirmation=1

Aliens vs. Ghosts
Use Nukes, Electricity, Heat Rays and powerful Minions in this wave-based first person shooter providing endless hours of Ghost-slaying entertainment, solo or Co-Op.
Only Ghosts stand in the way of your invasion of Earth.
